completion_notes: Unpackerr has no web interface and extracts nothing until it is pointed at a Starr application. Uncomment the [sonarr.0] or [radarr.0] section in /config/unpackerr.conf inside the container, set its url and api_key, then restart the container.
The same connection can be given as container variables instead of the file: UN_SONARR_0_URL and UN_SONARR_0_API_KEY, or the UN_RADARR_0_ equivalents.

tagline.en_US: Background archive extraction for Arr download queues. No web interface.

description.en_US: Unpackerr is an archive extraction daemon for download hosts and seedboxes. It identifies completed downloads and extracts archives recursively so media managers like Lidarr, Radarr, Readarr, and Sonarr can automatically import them. It can also operate standalone to monitor designated watch folders and automatically extract archives or split audio files using cue sheets.
